rules.nonzero: called("deposit") and ok and arg(0) > 0 and ret == 0
rules.fair_out: called("withdraw") and ok and wide(ret) * pre("totalSupply") > wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalAssets")
rules.dep_supply: called("deposit") and ok and post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") + ret
rules.wd_assets: called("withdraw") and ok and post("totalAssets") + ret != pre("totalAssets")
rules.don_assets: called("donate") and ok and post("totalAssets") != pre("totalAssets") + arg(0)
rules.dep_assets: called("deposit") and ok and post("totalAssets") != pre("totalAssets") + arg(0)
rules.wd_supply: called("withdraw") and ok and post("totalSupply") + arg(0) != pre("totalSupply")
rules.exit: called("withdraw") and reverted and arg(0) > 0 and arg(0) <= pre("shares", sender)
rules.enter: called("deposit") and reverted and (arg(0) > 0 and (pre("totalSupply") == 0 or wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply") >= pre("totalAssets")))
rules.wd_mine: called("withdraw") and ok and post("shares", sender) + arg(0) != pre("shares", sender)
rules.fair_out_floor: called("withdraw") and ok and wide(ret + 1) * pre("totalSupply") <= wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalAssets")
rules.fair_in: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret) * pre("totalAssets") > wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")
rules.fair_in_floor: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret + 1) * pre("totalAssets") <= wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")
rules.price: ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("totalAssets")) * pre("totalSupply") < wide(pre("totalAssets")) * post("totalSupply")
